caption:
Screen points don't count. 🎯

Same board, two plans. One throws 10 minutes a day. One plays darts on his phone. Day 30, his arm is sore. Next day, he throws again. A year later: 444 bullseyes vs 913 phone games.

Listen to the misses turn into thuds.

Send this to someone who's a pro on his phone.

#darts #practice #discipline #habits #motivation
